texts.zh:
以太相引擎的第一阶段建设已经宣告完工。我们开始研究虚境的能量，后者已经在全星系范围内发送灵能激波。

我们在虚境已经立下了一个脆弱的立足点——但我们必须继续建设引擎，以拓展我们在虚境的存在。
texts.en:
The first phase of the construction of the Aetherophasic Engine has been completed. We are beginning to tap into the energies of the Shroud, which is sending psionic shockwaves across the galaxy.

A tenuous foothold has been established - work must continue on the Engine to expand our presence in the Shroud.

label.zh: 我们必须收集更多的暗物质。
label.en: We must gather more dark matter.

texts.zh:
最近，一场巨大的灵能震波横扫了整个星系！它似乎是从[From.GetName]的[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]恒星系发出来的。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]正在尽可能解释这种事件的成因——这在星系是史无前例的。

即便在虚境自身内部也回荡着这场不可思议事件的回响。
texts.en:
A massive psionic shockwave recently swept across the galaxy! It seems to have emanated from the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system in the [From.GetName]. Our [GetTelepathPlural] are struggling to explain what could have caused such an event - nothing like it has been recorded in galactic history.

Even in the Shroud itself, echoes of this incredible event are being felt.

texts.zh:
最近，一场巨大的灵能震波横扫了整个星系！它似乎是从[From.GetName]的[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]恒星系发出来的。我们找不到这样事件的任何可能成因，即便集体中的灵能子个体也无法理解这种前所未有的现象。

即便在虚境自身内部也回荡着这场不可思议事件的回响。
texts.en:
A massive psionic shockwave recently swept across the galaxy! It seems to have emanated from the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system in the [From.GetName]. We have no explanation for what could have caused such an event, even our psionic drones within the collective are unable to comprehend such an unprecedented phenomenon.

Even in the Shroud itself, echoes of this incredible event are being felt.

texts.zh:
又一股大规模的灵能激波横扫了星系！这一次激波的中心源是[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系的[From.GetName]。

如同上次一样，这次事件也在整个虚境掀起了涟漪。
texts.en:
Yet another massive psionic shockwave has swept across the galaxy! This time it emanated from the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system in the [From.GetName].

As before, this event is sending ripples across the entire Shroud.

texts.zh:
我们在[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]星系检测到了微弱的灵能和能量信号，其读数和我们自己的以太相引擎几乎完全一致。

看来[From.GetName]也打算染指虚境！
texts.en:
We have detected faint psionic and energy signatures from the [crisis_sphere_system.GetName] system that are nearly identical to our own Aetherophasic Engine.

It would seem that the [From.GetName] also intends to lay claim to the Shroud!
